title.value: Guiding the Growth: Difficulty-Controllable Question Generation through Step-by-Step Rewriting
title.justification: The title is clearly stated in the header of the paper.
title.quote: Guiding the Growth: Difficulty-Controllable Question Generation through Step-by-Step Rewriting

analysis.description: This paper addresses the task of Difficulty-Controllable Question Generation, redefining question difficulty by the inference steps required to answer. A new framework for step-by-step rewriting questions under an extracted reasoning chain is presented, and a dataset is constructed for experimentation and testing. The framework has shown to effectively control question difficulty with high quality.

type.justification: The paper involves experimentation using an automatically constructed dataset and compares performance with baseline methods.
type.quote: A dataset is automatically constructed to facilitate the research, on which extensive experiments are conducted to test the performance of our method.

name.justification: The key focus of the research is on generating questions with different levels of difficulty.

name.justification: The paper relates to Question Answering as it defines difficulty in terms of steps required for a QA system to answer generated questions.
name.quote: Compared to previous QG works which control the interrogative word (Zi et al., 2019; Kang et al., 2019) or the context of a question (Liu et al., 2020, 2019a), few works have been conducted on diffic- ulty control, as it is hard to formally define the difficulty of a question.
